summary: Full stack testing of KinoRez (TMDB proxy + Expo RN frontend). Backend: 21/21 pytest cases passed against public URL (home, search, collections, collection detail, movie/tv detail). Frontend: verified Home ('Сейчас смотрят' title + 5 filter chips + 3-col poster grid with real TMDB posters, ratings, years, Russian titles), Collections tab (10 gradient tiles), Collection Detail (Боевики grid), Detail (hero backdrop, meta, stats, cast, similar, bookmark toggle), Watch sheet flow (Озвучка/Сезон/Серия/Качество), Player (YouTube iframe loads with real trailer key), Search FAB (typed 'аватар' -> 40 poster results, clear works), Profile (account card, Досмотреть sheet showed the recently opened title, Auth register updates account card with логин/выйти). Deprecated RN web warnings detected: textShadow* and props.pointerEvents.

integration_issues.issue: After bookmarking an item on Detail then tapping the 'Закладки' menu row on Profile, the sheet-bookmarks was not visible in one run (Досмотреть sheet worked correctly). Could be selector matching a text descendant rather than the Pressable row. Manual re-test suggested to confirm; menu row testIDs are missing which forced text-based selection.

react_native_issues.issue: textShadow* style props are deprecated. Use the shorthand 'textShadow'. Reference: /app/frontend/app/detail/[type]/[id].tsx:326
props.pointerEvents is deprecated in RN web. Move pointerEvents='box-none' to style.pointerEvents. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx:28

action_items: Add testID props to Profile menu rows (e.g. profile-menu-bookmarks / profile-menu-recent / profile-menu-updates) so the outer Pressable can be targeted reliably from tests without relying on text matching.
Replace deprecated textShadowColor/textShadowOffset/textShadowRadius with the new 'textShadow' shorthand in detail hero title.
Move `pointerEvents='box-none'` from the View prop to `style.pointerEvents` in FloatingTabBar in (tabs)/_layout.tsx.
Optional: manually verify Закладки sheet opens after bookmarking (Recent sheet works; likely just a selector-scope test artefact, not a functional bug).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `test_detail_not_found` returns 502 (TMDB 404 bubbled through raise_for_status). Consider catching 404 specifically and returning 404 with 'Не найдено' for proper HTTP semantics.

Backend uses synchronous `requests` inside `def` endpoints which blocks the event loop under load. For a proxy of TMDB, an async httpx client (or `run_in_threadpool`) would scale better; acceptable for MVP.
MongoDB is present in .env but unused by server.py — either remove MONGO_URL/DB_NAME or wire persistence for future auth.
TMDB_API_KEY is loaded via `os.environ[...]` (fails-fast, good). Ensure it stays out of any client bundle (currently only backend, verified).

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical flows verified; one non-blocking Bookmarks-sheet selector artefact)

seed_data_creation: None. Frontend recent/bookmarks are populated live during testing via useStore.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend is a TMDB proxy — no DB writes, so all backend tests are read-only and idempotent. Frontend tabs live under /(tabs). PosterCard testID is `poster-{media_type}-{id}`. Watch sheet flow testIDs: watch-button -> opt-voice/opt-season/opt-episode -> watch-continue -> quality-{i} -> /player. Profile sheet testIDs: sheet-recent/sheet-bookmarks/sheet-updates/sheet-downloads/sheet-logout (but the menu rows that open them lack testIDs — must be targeted by text until fixed). Auth testIDs: auth-tab-login/register, auth-name/email/pass, auth-submit, auth-back.
